claims.evidence: Witness photos show a large industrial machine/engine-like unit inside a white cargo van, with scattered loose parts; no 3-wheel trike/motorbike is shown.
No customs documents, receipts, or markings are shown in the witness report.
No tyres or wheel/vehicle details are visible in the witness photos.
The witness report only notes used-looking dust/debris and loose parts; no tamper-proofing or seals are shown.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch: seller claims a 3-wheel trike, but the witness photos show an industrial machine/engine-like unit; this can mean wrong item or scam.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the full 3-wheel trike (front, rear, wheels/tyres, frame) in the van, plus a close-up of any brand/model badge reading 'Ryker'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used industrial machine/engine-like unit with incomplete accessories and no proof of working condition.

risks.risk: Completeness risk: loose parts are scattered and it’s unclear whether all components, accessories, and manuals are included.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo laid out on the floor (all parts in one frame) and a photo showing the machine fully assembled/complete.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts-only or missing accessories risk.

risks.risk: Working condition risk: no testing/running status is shown; dust/debris suggests it may be used and possibly non-functional.
risks.proof: A short video of the unit starting/running (or a power-on test) with sound and stable operation, plus any error lights/status indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / not working.

risks.risk: Damage/corrosion risk: damage details are not clear from the angle; corrosion/cracks could exist on panels, grille/stack, or mounting points.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides: front grille/stack, top red/black section, base/mounting points, and any seams—taken in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for wear/damage not visible in the current shots.

risks.risk: Specs/compatibility risk: power requirements (voltage/fuel) and intended use are unknown, affecting buyer’s ability to operate it.
risks.proof: A photo of the nameplate/spec label (voltage, frequency, model, serial number) and any wiring/fuel connection labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring verification of compatibility.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the actual item being sold: full view of the 3-wheel trike (all wheels/tyres visible) if it is truly a Ryker trike.
If it is an industrial machine instead, send the machine’s make/model nameplate close-up and a full assembled shot.
Provide a video showing the unit starting/running (or a documented test) and any operational indicators.
Provide an itemized inventory photo of all loose parts included, and confirm whether manuals/tools are included.
Provide customs documentation/receipt evidence if claiming 'original full custom duty'.
response.reason: The witness photos do not match the seller’s claimed item (trike vs industrial machine), and key pricing drivers (exact identity, completeness, and working condition) are not verifiable from the current report. Proof is required before any reliable pricing.
